# tests/test_title_case.py
import pytest

from your_module import title_case  # Replace "your_module" with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        ("hello world", "Hello World"),
        ("hello", "Hello"),
        ("hELLO wORLD", "Hello World"),
        ("already Title Case", "Already Title Case"),
        ("hello, world!", "Hello, World!"),
        ("foo-bar baz_qux", "Foo-bar Baz_qux"),
        ("o'NEILL is HERE", "O'neill Is Here"),
        ("123ABC abc123", "123abc Abc123"),
    ],
)
def test_title_case_happy_path(s, expected):
    assert title_case(s) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        ("", ""),
        ("   ", ""),
        ("\t\n\r", ""),
        ("  hello   world  ", "Hello World"),
        ("hello\tworld\npython", "Hello World Python"),
        ("one\r\ntwo\vthree\ffour", "One Two Three Four"),
    ],
)
def test_title_case_edge_cases(s, expected):
    assert title_case(s) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_input", [None, 123, 3.14, [], {}, object()])
def test_title_case_invalid_inputs_without_split_raise_attribute_error(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError, match="split"):
        title_case(bad_input)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def test_title_case_bytes_input_raises_type_error():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        title_case(b"hello world")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
